common.underConstructionBody: This module ships in {phase}. The navigation is already wired so you can walk through it.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: We'll email you a sign-in link. No password to remember.
auth.linkSent: Done. Check {email} and open the link on this same device.
auth.sendFailed: Couldn't send the link. Try again in a moment.
auth.callbackFailed: That link didn't work or has expired. Request a new one.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Your account isn't allowed into the admin panel. If you think that's a mistake, talk to the owner.

dashboard.title: Financial summary
dashboard.description: Sales, margin, cash by currency, and inventory at cost and at market.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: Cards, boxes, and lots, with allocated cost and market value.
inventory.emptyAll: No inventory yet. Start by registering a purchase.
inventory.results: {count, plural, =0 {no results} one {# piece} other {# pieces}}

totals.title: Inventory value
totals.hiddenCosts: {count, plural, one {# piece with no visible cost} other {# pieces with no visible cost}}
totals.consignedNote: It's in the vault but belongs to others: it doesn't add to your equity.
totals.consumedNote: Its cost already moved to the cards that came out. Not counted twice.
totals.notComputable: Can't be computed without every cost.

detail.notFound: That piece doesn't exist or was deleted.

blocked.STATUS_NOT_SELLABLE: Its status doesn't allow selling it.
blocked.NO_PHOTO: It needs at least one photo: a listing without a photo isn't a listing.
blocked.BELOW_CONSIGNOR_MIN: The price is below the minimum agreed with the consignor.
blocked.CONSIGNMENT_TERMS_UNKNOWN: This is a consigned card and your role can't see the agreement. Ask the owner.

sell.title: Sell
sell.description: Fast point of sale and store orders with payment verification.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.description: Auction lots, shared costs, and allocation by hammer price.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Balances by account and currency, movements, FX, and reconciliation.

receivables.title: Outstanding
receivables.description: Receivables and payables, with days overdue and reminders.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Profile, purchase history, wishlist, and segments.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Income statement, turnover, aging, and FX differential.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: Natural-language questions about inventory, sales, and finances.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Accounts, channel fees, consignment commission, and store details.

home.title: Collectible cards and sealed boxes
home.subtitle: Graded, raw, and sealed. Sports and TCG.
